verdict.rationale: Intel documents a real developer toolchain (oneAPI, oneDNN, VTune Profiler, SYCL interoperability, PyTorch optimizations) specifically targeting Core Ultra CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, which supports the claim of first-class tooling and optimization guidance. However, all evidence is first-party marketing/docs with no independent benchmarks, compiler maturity comparisons, or third-party developer testimonials confirming tier-one treatment across OSes/toolchains. Missing for 10: independent compiler/toolchain maturity assessments, cross-OS (Linux/Windows) tooling parity evidence, and third-party developer adoption/testimonial data.
